title: Editor watermark
description: Empty editor group: VS Code letterpress and shortcut hints.
usage: Inside <vsc-editor> when no editor is open. Children: <vsc-watermark-entry>.

examples.title: Empty editor
examples.html: <vsc-watermark style="height: 831px;"><vsc-watermark-entry icon="watermark-chat" label="Open Chat" keys="Ctrl+Alt+I"></vsc-watermark-entry><vsc-watermark-entry icon="watermark-commands" label="Show All Commands" keys="Ctrl+Shift+P"></vsc-watermark-entry><vsc-watermark-entry icon="watermark-settings" label="Open Settings" keys="Ctrl+,"></vsc-watermark-entry></vsc-watermark>

examples.title: Shortcuts rotate
examples.html: <vsc-watermark style="height: 831px;"><vsc-watermark-entry icon="watermark-chat" label="Open Chat" keys="Ctrl+Alt+I"></vsc-watermark-entry><vsc-watermark-entry icon="watermark-commands" label="Show All Commands" keys="Ctrl+Shift+P"></vsc-watermark-entry><vsc-watermark-entry icon="watermark-find-in-files" label="Find in Files" keys="Ctrl+Shift+F"></vsc-watermark-entry></vsc-watermark>
examples.description: VS Code shows a rotating subset of shortcuts.
